geometry.derivationNote: The cited Federal Constitutional Law establishes the project russian-legal-border scope/date. The corresponding pinned public-domain Natural Earth 1:10m admin-1 polygon supplies the deterministic administrative outline referenced by that legal definition. This project track remains separate from international-recognition and de-facto-control tracks.

territoryChanges.notes: Geometry-verified for the Russian domestic legal-border track only; no assertion of international recognition or de-facto control.
